Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`), estVoice (s: the predicted voice length, tools/estimate.py; replaced by the real voice once tools/voice.py has run).

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Pauloma sub-parva. CHECKED AGAINST CE 1.5.1–26 and 1.6.1–2 (GRETIL text of the constituted edition, lab/ce): Shaunaka asks to hear the Bhargava line first (1.5.3); Puloma, Bhrigu's wife, is with child (1.5.11–12); Bhrigu has gone out for his ablution when the rakshasa comes (1.5.13); she receives him with forest fruit and roots (1.5.15); he is seized by desire and wishes to carry her off (1.5.14, 16); he sees the fire burning in the fire-house and asks it: tell me, Agni, whose wife is this; you are truthful, tell me the truth (1.5.17–18: the hook and `press` are this verse in paraphrase); he had chosen her first, and afterwards her father gave her to Bhrigu (1.5.19); if she is Bhrigu's wife he means to take her (1.5.20); doubting, he asks again and again (1.5.22: "He had to be sure it was she"); Agni moves within all beings like a witness (1.5.23); Agni, afraid of untruth and of Bhrigu's curse, speaks softly (1.5.26); hearing Agni, the rakshasa carries her off in a boar's form with the speed of mind and wind (1.6.1); the child falls from the womb (1.6.2, the cliffhanger). CE AGAINST VULGATE: the constituted text gives Agni NO words at 1.5.26; his reply ("she is Bhrigu's wife…") is star passage 220*, and the narrator's account of the betrothal is 217*: both are apparatus, not CE, and are not used; we say only that the fire told him who she was. "You are the mouth of the gods" is NOT in the rakshasa's speech (the image is Agni's own, 1.7.10–11) and was removed from this episode. ORDER OF TELLING: in the text the Pauloma parva (1.4–12) is told BEFORE the Astika parva (1.13–53); the series tells it after. The recap band and the source line say so. The rakshasa's name (Puloman; the CE's stem is puloman) is on his plaque and not spoken.
structure: From episode 41 (the step-up; script/ARC-41-50.md): COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words, spoken by ≤ 2.8 s; the hook style rotates and never repeats the episode before) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 4.5 s with the UNVOICED recap band → the episode stands alone (every name has an identifier in "names", shown as a plaque) → one question closed (loop.answeredBy), the previous one answered by 15 s (loop.prevAnsweredBy) → turn at 40–60 % after a real silence, a second silence where the story allows → one face close-up with a change of emotion → one signature shot → the cliffhanger with the source line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band that dissolves into frame 1. Per line: pal (the colour script: no hue for more than two lines), cam (≥ 4 distinct moves), tr (transitions born from the medium), amb / foley / music (three sound layers; ambLead / ambLag = J- and L-cuts). Gate: tools/gate.mjs.

names.Agni: the fire, witness of every rite

loop.hookQuestion: Whose wife is she, and will the fire say so?
loop.openQuestion: What can an unborn child do against a demon?

strings.recapLine: In the text this tale comes first: Shaunaka asks for his own family's story.
strings.sourceLine: Adi Parva 1.5–6 · told before the serpent tales · BORI Critical Edition

lines.speaker: puloman
lines.text: "Tell me, Fire: whose wife is she?"
lines.say: Tell me, Fire: [p:60] whose wife is she?
lines.note: COLD OPEN (direct speech in medias res): inside the hut, the rakshasa (back-lit by the household fire, the new rim-and-fill rule) stands before the household fire (the series' layered flame on its altar; it has no face); Puloma, large and lit, behind, a clear gap between the three. The question as a card low in the frame, not at the top (a new first frame for the series).

lines.speaker: elder_sage
lines.text: "Sauti, tell me of my own family."
lines.say: Sauti, [p:120] tell me of my own family.
lines.note: FRAME with the unvoiced recap band (top): the Naimisha fire at the blue hour; Shaunaka (plaque: Shaunaka · chief of the forest sages) turns to Sauti. A J-cut: the night fire is heard before the picture. Pays off episode 40's last line by 5 s.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: Your line begins with the sage Bhrigu and his wife, Puloma.
lines.say: Your line begins [p:80] with the sage Bhrigu [p:100] and his wife, Puloma.
lines.note: FRAME: Sauti answers; in the smoke over the fire two figures form: a tall sage and a woman with child (plaques: Bhrigu · a great sage; Puloma · his wife).

lines.text: Puloma was with child. Bhrigu had gone to bathe.
lines.say: Puloma was with child. [p:200] Bhrigu had gone to bathe.
lines.note: STORY 1 · NEW LIGHT, the hermitage at morning (hermitage-green; five planes: sky, hills, tree line, the hut, foreground trunks; shafts and pollen). Puloma at the door, a hand on her belly; Bhrigu walks away toward the river with his water-pot. A crane down from the canopy.

lines.text: A rakshasa came: a demon who had once chosen her.
lines.say: A rakshasa came: [p:200] a demon who had once chosen her.
lines.note: STORY 2: a rack focus from Puloma (near, lit) to the broad horned figure coming through the trees (plaque: Puloman · a rakshasa). She offers him fruit as a guest (the text has it).

lines.text: But her father had given her to Bhrigu.
lines.say: But her father [p:60] had given her to Bhrigu.
lines.note: STORY 3 · NEW LIGHT, inside the hut by the household fire (hearth-amber): a lamp-glow match cut from the sun to the fire. A small memory in the smoke: the marriage rite, hands joined over a fire.

lines.text: He had to be sure it was she. He asked the household fire: Agni, the witness.
lines.say: He had to be sure it was she. [p:250] He asked the household fire: [p:200] Agni, [p:80] the witness.
lines.note: STORY 4 · THE TURN (≈ 47 %) after a real silence: a demon asks the truth of a witness. The flame rises and steadies as he speaks to it (plaque: Agni · the fire, witness of every rite); no face on the fire. The rakshasa back-lit, readable (rim on both sides, a cool fill).

lines.speaker: puloman
lines.text: "You are truthful, Fire. Tell me the truth."
lines.say: You are truthful, Fire. [p:250] Tell me the truth.
lines.note: STORY 5 · THE CLOSE-UP: Puloma's face in the doorway's green daylight as she hears him: calm to fear (brow, eyelid, a glance to the fire). The demon's voice over her face.

lines.text: Agni feared to lie. He feared the sage's curse.
lines.say: Agni feared to lie. [p:250] He feared the sage's curse.
lines.note: STORY 6: the fire troubled: the flames sink, lean away and waver; a tilt down from the smoke to the flame's heart.

lines.text: Softly, the fire told him who she was.
lines.say: Softly, [p:250] the fire told him who she was.
lines.note: STORY 7 (a second real silence before it) · THE SIGNATURE SHOT: frame-within-frame, the three of them seen through the hut's dark doorway; the flame bends once toward the rakshasa and one tongue of it points at her; the word of the turn: TRUTH, placed clear of every face. cam: frame.

lines.text: The demon became a boar, seized her, and ran like the wind.
lines.say: The demon became a boar, [p:100] seized her, [p:100] and ran like the wind.
lines.note: STORY 8 · NEW LIGHT, a bruised dusk (boar-dusk): a smoke carry out of the hut; the great boar runs across the frame with her carried on its shoulders, small and upright against the sky (no grappling, no overlap of her body with its head), trunks passing in the foreground (parallax), leaves in the wind.

lines.text: Then the child in her womb fell to the ground, blazing.
lines.say: Then the child in her womb [p:100] fell to the ground, [p:250] blazing.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (the catalog's cliffhanger): a white-gold light bursts under the boar; it rears. A pull back. The source line appears (top).
The NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image, with the source line; dissolve into frame 1.
